open.expected: No preparation write to the replacement inode, including fresh run-root creation; refuse or create only through the pinned original parent, preserving original failure diagnostics.
open.actual: Inherited _prepare performs tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=self.directory) before _DeploymentArchive.register checks parent identity; one empty lvw-s2-default-* directory is created in the replacement parent, then preparation parent identity drift is raised.
open.evidence: raw/gap.stdout.log; INDEPENDENT_EARLY_LIFECYCLE plus failed unexpected == [] assertion

open.why_not_relocated_inode_exception: The new directory is created under the replacement parent inode, rather than the relocated original pinned parent.
open.remediation_obligation: Bind fresh root allocation to the original parent across complete verification and registration; preserve legacy S2 behavior and existing production owner calls, root adjudicates authorized seam.
